description: This file implements the SetVideoGeometry class, which is responsible for setting the video geometry in a media player context. It includes methods for construction, destruction, and execution of the geometry setting operation, interacting with a media pipeline and a private player interface.

classes.name: SetVideoGeometry
classes.description: A class that manages setting the video geometry for a media player within a specific context, including logging and interaction with the player and pipeline.

methods.name: SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetVideoGeometry object with the given context, player, and rectangle.

methods.name: ~SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the SetVideoGeometry object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the operation to set the video geometry, updating the context and calling the player method if the pipeline exists.
